Enterprise Services · Operational Outsourcing

Scale your operations without scaling your headcount.

Kleza provides dedicated, domain-trained outsourcing teams for healthcare and enterprise organisations — covering US accounting, HR recruitment, scheduling coordination, and administrative operations. Your team. Our delivery.

Talk to Our Outsourcing Team See What We Cover
The In-House Cost

Growing operational demand with a fixed internal headcount is a compounding problem — and hiring to solve it is expensive.

Home care agencies spend an average of 30% of operational capacity on scheduling and administrative functions alone — and for most healthcare organisations the operational burden is disproportionate to team size.

Kleza’s outsourcing model solves this without growing your internal headcount — with teams trained specifically for your industry, operating as an extension of your own organisation.

  • Scheduling under strainCoordinators managing more shifts than is sustainable, with coverage gaps appearing as volume grows.
  • HR stretched thinRecruitment, onboarding, and compliance running simultaneously on a fixed internal team.
  • Accounting coverage gapUS-time-zone financial coverage required — without a US-cost-base staffing model.

The Model

How our outsourcing model works.

Not a shared resource pool. Dedicated people, trained for your operational reality, working under signed compliance agreements.

01

Dedicated Teams, Not Shared Resources

Your outsourced team members work exclusively for your organisation during agreed hours. They learn your systems, your culture, and your way of working. You are not buying slots in a shared pool — you are gaining dedicated people.

02

Domain Training Before Day One

Every team member Kleza places is trained on your industry’s operational context before they start. For healthcare clients, that means US home care scheduling norms, HIPAA awareness, caregiver communication standards, and your specific software systems.

03

Compliance Assurance Built In

Kleza maintains signed confidentiality and data handling agreements for all outsourcing engagements. For healthcare clients, all team members handling client or patient-adjacent data operate under HIPAA-compliant protocols.

Healthcare Specialisation · HIPAA

Built for the operational reality of home care and healthcare services.

  • Home care schedulingManaging caregiver availability, shift assignments, and last-minute coverage across complex client rosters.
  • Healthcare HR recruitmentSourcing, screening, and onboarding caregivers and healthcare staff to US compliance standards.
  • US healthcare accountingFinancial operations support for home care agencies, staffing firms, and healthcare providers.
  • HIPAA-aware operationsAll team members handling client-adjacent data trained on HIPAA compliance requirements.

Case Study

Scaling a home care agency’s scheduling operation — without a single additional US hire.

98%
Shift coverage rate post-deployment, up from 87% prior.
Client
Regional home care agency · United States
Challenge

A fast-growing home care agency was struggling with scheduling coverage as client volume grew 40% in 12 months. Internal coordinators were consistently overloaded, leading to missed shifts and caregiver churn.

Approach

Kleza deployed two dedicated scheduling coordinators, trained on the agency’s scheduling software and caregiver roster, both operating during US business hours.

Outcome

Shift coverage improved from 87% to 98% within 60 days and internal coordinator overtime fell by 60% — the agency continued scaling without adding US-based administrative headcount.

Illustrative engagement — metrics to be verified against approved client data before publishing.
